title: Prove A5 shortening and exclude P112 2,5^2,6^6,7
body:
## Summary

Prove a characteristic-zero P112 shortening lemma with common small support at most 29, then exclude the actual TWOSIDE `(6,4)` profile `2,5^2,6^6,7`.

```text
10 independent pieces, code dimension >=6
    delete the unrestricted last piece
9 independent pieces, code dimension >=5
    common small support <=26, six endpoint supports <=20
A5 endpoint requirement >=128 > allowance 120
```

The A5 spectrum is inherited from Nick Petalas/PR3188 and the deletion method from PR3195. PR3197's support 24 application is credited. DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 supplies TWOSIDE and the original filter; retained geometry preserves the E8/P112 lineage, including joaqcoo. Exact heads, blobs, hashes, proof, evidence, reproduction and open questions are in [the package](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/f7951d9ca99feb1e54660dbe239941f6187948b1/research/p112-a5-shortening). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19001621).

## Evidence

- **Before:** the coordinate inequality gives only `795<=800` at support 26 and cannot exclude this caller.
- **After:** the full A5 spectrum requires `128>120`; the general support 29 lemma still gives `122>120`. At support 30 both the strict count and root-only premise cease to certify a contradiction.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and all 18 optimized behavioral controls pass, including complete historical-table validation, source/receipt corruption and ambient-module collisions. The exact committed read-only Git-free export passes replay and all 18 controls on CPython 3.13.16. All 19 publication-byte comparisons pass. Ruff, formatting and compilation checks pass.
- Finite coverage includes all 4,097,782 five-/six-flats, 7,140 root planes, 960 reflections and complete A5 extension orbits. Internal mathematical and fresh artifact reviews found no remaining substantive objection. Evidence is author-checked; independent human and proof-kernel review remain separate.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
RUN="$HOME/.cache/integer-mult-bounds-runs/a5-shortening-review"
mkdir -p "$RUN"
TMPDIR="$RUN" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a5-shortening
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only the new research package changes. This closes one actual profile, not full C5, the complete decoder floor, a supplier or a new kappa. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and original decoder reduction remain dependencies. The selected frontier and frozen inputs are unchanged; no full supplier cold replay, Lean or Docker build is claimed. Development used substantial automated drafting and finite checks.
